# OpenAPI and AsyncAPI

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from api_spec/lang.json and api_spec/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//api_spec:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//api_spec:defs.bzl", "api_spec_go_client", "api_spec_library")
```

## Rules

### `api_spec_go_client`

Generates one Go client file (types and client) with oapi-codegen from an OpenAPI root of an api_spec_library.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `out` | `string` | no | Output file name; defaults to NAME.go. |
| `package` | `string` | yes | Go package name of the generated file. |
| `root` | `label` | no | The root document; required when the spec has more than one. |
| `spec` | `label` | yes | The api_spec_library to generate from. |
| `_driver` | `label` | no |  |
| `_oapi_codegen` | `label` | no |  |
| `_preflight` | `label` | no |  |

### `api_spec_library`

Owns the OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documents of one package for dx quality.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Root OpenAPI or AsyncAPI documents to lint. |
| `refs` | `label_list` | no | Files the roots reach through relative $ref. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Spec libraries the roots reach through relative $ref. |

### `api_spec_python_client`

Generates one Python client package directory with openapi-python-client from an OpenAPI root of an api_spec_library.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `out` | `string` | no | Output directory name; defaults to NAME. |
| `root` | `label` | no | The root document; required when the spec has more than one. |
| `spec` | `label` | yes | The api_spec_library to generate from. |
| `_config` | `label` | no |  |
| `_generator` | `label` | no |  |
| `_preflight` | `label` | no |  |

### `api_spec_rust_client`

Generates one Rust client file with progenitor from an OpenAPI root of an api_spec_library. The file needs progenitor-client, reqwest, serde and serde_json at compile time.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `out` | `string` | no | Output file name; defaults to NAME.rs. |
| `root` | `label` | no | The root document; required when the spec has more than one. |
| `spec` | `label` | yes | The api_spec_library to generate from. |
| `_generator` | `label` | no |  |
| `_preflight` | `label` | no |  |

### `api_spec_typescript_client`

Generates one self-contained TypeScript client from an OpenAPI root of an api_spec_library.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `out` | `string` | no | Output file name; defaults to NAME.ts. |
| `root` | `label` | no | The root document; required when the spec has more than one. |
| `spec` | `label` | yes | The api_spec_library to generate from. |
| `_config` | `label` | no |  |
| `_preflight` | `label` | no |  |
| `_redocly` | `label` | no |  |
